title: arctium alepideae
intro: Arctium alepideae, commonly known as Lesser Burdock, is a biennial herbaceous plant belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lesser Burdock are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Arctium alepideae include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
